relationship: EnteleLEDGER is a separate TVK Group ecosystem infrastructure project. Its verifiable-record and ledger capabilities may be evaluated for future use within EnteleBANK only through formal architecture, security, data-governance, legal, outsourcing and regulatory assessment.
bankStatus: EnteleBANK is a proposed UK banking institution in pre-authorisation development. It is not currently authorised by the PRA or FCA to accept deposits or provide regulated banking services.
boundary: EnteleLEDGER is not a bank, bank account, deposit product, payment account or FSCS-protected service, and ecosystem affiliation does not make EnteleLEDGER an EnteleBANK banking service.
futureIntegration: Any future integration must preserve regulated-entity accountability, customer protection, operational resilience, auditability, data controls and clear supplier/technology boundaries.
